name: Question 1
worked_solution:
If $Z∼N(0,1),$ then by the definition of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z),$ 

$$
P(Z\le z)=Φ(z).
$$

Also, since $Z$ is continuous, 

$$
P(Z<-2.17)=P(Z\le -2.17)=Φ(-2.17).
$$

The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14254773/assets/eb01b718ca3f376cf50b7d3b7729b82dbc5b4a489519aedb06b15deacf466660.png)

Now, we determine the value of $Φ(-2.17)$ from the table:

- We first select the row that corresponds to $-2.1$ and the column that corresponds to $0.07.$

- Then, we take the value that lies at the intersection:

| $z$ | $\,0.07\,$ | $\,0.08\,$ | $\,0.09\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,-2.2\,$ | $\,0.0116\,$ | $\,0.0113\,$ | $\,0.0110\,$ |
| $\,-2.1\,$ | $\,0.0150\,$ | $\,0.0146\,$ | $\,0.0143\,$ |
| $\,-2.0\,$ | $\,0.0192\,$ | $\,0.0188\,$ | $\,0.0183\,$ |

Therefore, according to the table, we have

$$
P(Z\le -2.17)=Φ(-2.17)=0.0150.
$$
